name: GDPR
fullName: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council (General Data Protection Regulation)
publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
appliesTo: Controllers and processors that process personal data in the context of an EU/EEA establishment, or that offer goods/services to or monitor people in the EU.
note: Covers the obligation-bearing articles an organisation typically evidences; definitions, supervisory-authority and remedies chapters are omitted, and a mapped control supports but does not by itself demonstrate compliance with an article.
